en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town street with a bridge in the foreground leading toward several townhouses. A man walks on the bridge and a horse‑drawn vehicle is visible further up the street. On the right side rises a prominent Baroque‑style Catholic church with an ornate tower and cross. Decorative lampposts line the bridge. Red printed German text appears at the top and bottom margins.
